$comment: Canon repository. Copilot supplies the sole automated review round; a separate APPROVED review is not required, and the maintainer's human merge decision remains outside this automated readiness verdict. `approval_policy: "review-round-only"` is what makes the empty `default_approvers` legal and is load-bearing in both directions -- deleting it makes the loader refuse the empty approval set. Modelled on the canon sibling's file so the two repositories are judged by the same reviewer vocabulary.

delivery.$comment: Delivery branches follow the {model}/{persona}/{descriptor} template under the maintainer's own credentials.

round_policy.$comment: Maintainer's rulings of 2026-09-19 (zheref/hatsu#85). stallMinutes is read by nen pr ready (v0.11.0): a pending review request older than it reads not-ready: reviewer round stalled. minRounds and maxRounds are Hatsu's own keys, read by the skills: an owed reviewer round is requested on the maintainer's behalf while the PR's requested rounds are under maxRounds; at maxRounds the run ends at not-ready with the board, never with a question. monitor.maxCycles in nen/workflow.json is a different number -- en's ACTING-cycle cap.
